messages:
incidents-bot: Pager — HIGH: spike in 502/504 errors at api-gateway-edge-us-west (rule: gateway-5xx-threshold). Incident channel: #incidents. Pager link: https://pager.redwood.example/incident/INC-2041 :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now.

sre-lee: I see 502s from gw-edge -> upstream 'inference-proxy-usw1' timeouts. Error pattern: "upstream timed out (504)" and occasional 'bad response (502)'. Rolling TPS for gw-edge jumped from 1200 -> 4200 in last 3m.

platform-jordan: @oncall-alex, can you increase gw-edge autoscale target and flip traffic to fallback pool? I'll prep the routing override.

oncall-alex: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy gw-edge --replicas=12 -n prod` -> should add capacity, doing a rolling restart for unhealthy pods.

eng-runtime-maya: logs show a sudden surge of small requests with long header sizes, looks like clients retrying fast. Could be client-side retry storm. Also seeing a spike in backend connection resets to model-inference: `504 read timeout`.

support-rachel: Customer Impact bot: 24 customers currently reporting errors via status page. Top affected: AcmeCorp (timeouts), SnapshotIO (502). Created internal ticket INF-3881 and notified AE.

platform-jordan: routing override applied: all US-WEST edge requests -> fallback-gw pool (lower spec) for 10m. Monitoring now.

sre-lee: applying per-route circuit-breaker to upstream inference-proxy to cap concurrent connections: `envoy config patch ...` (done). This should reduce cascading failures.

eng-runtime-maya: trying a quick rollback of last gw config change? Any recent deploys 10-15m before spike?

oncall-alex: no gateway deploys in last 30m. There was a model backend deploy ~20m ago in inference-proxy cluster.

eng-runtime-maya: rollback of model deploy initiated (manual rollback to v2.3.7). It's rolling back now.

incidents-bot: Deploy rollback event: inference-proxy reverted to v2.3.7 by eng-runtime-maya at 1718275400.

sre-lee: after scaling + routing override + circuit breaker + rollback, 5xx rate dropping. 502s -> 3% from 18%, 504 -> 2% from 12% in last 5m. Keep watching 10m.

support-rachel: Notifying affected customers: message drafted and sent to top 10, PSAs on status page updated :email:

oncall-alex: monitoring: latency and error rate trending down. Keeping incident open for observation window (30m). If stable, will start recovery playbook.

customer-impact-bot: Current status: 36 impacted customers recorded, major customers: AcmeCorp, SnapshotIO. Severity set to SEV2.

eng-runtime-maya: one odd log snippet — large number of 413s too (request header too large) from ip-range 35.204.xxx. Could be proxy rewrite bug.

platform-jordan: added temporary header size limit relaxation on fallback pool to accept client traffic; will revert after.

sre-lee: final check: downstream model latency normalized, gateway CPU utilization back to baseline. Marking mitigation successful for now.

oncall-alex: incident update: Mitigations applied: scaled gw-edge, routing override to fallback pool, circuit-breaker to inference-proxy, rollback model deploy, adjusted header limits. Postmortem owner assigned: eng-runtime-maya. I'll hand off to oncall-night in 30m.

support-rachel: Logged customer-facing postmortem draft under INC-2041-customer-comms. Will wait for ops summary.

oncall-alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup: I'll update #incidents in 30m with final status.

sre-lee: watching. closing thread if stable.
